decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The retail store shall not be open before 0700 hours nor after 2200 hours on Monday to Saturday, nor before 1000 hours nor after 1700 hours on Sunday.

Condition : 2 - The barrier installed at the entrance to the car park as a result of planning consent 01106/B/92 shall be retained for the lifetime of the development, unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and shall be closed from 2300 hours to 0500 hours on Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 3 - Before the commencement of the development hereby permitted, a Car Park Management Strategy will be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and will be implemented and maintained for the lifetime of the development.
Condition : 4 - Deliveries to the retail store shall not take place between 23.00 hrs on Saturday and 07.00 hrs on the Sunday following.

Condition : 5 - No storage activity in connection with the retail use shall be carried on outside the retail building hereby permitted without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The site to be used for the purpose of a petrol filling station shall be used for that purpose only and no vehicle repairs or any other industrial process, as defined in the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order) shall be carried out on the premises, nor shall there be display of cars for sale.

Condition : 7 - Any noise emanating from equipment, plant, vehicle movement, vehicle refrigeration plant or operations being carried on at the site shall not exceed 10dB below background noise levels (measured as LA90) for the area, measured at the boundary for the site.  Any low frequency noise from the site shall not be perceptible in any nearby residential property.
description: Variation of condition 1 hours of operation of planning permission 01106/B/P92 dated 19/08/1999 to allow for opening hours from 7am to 10pm on Monday through to Saturday
